summary: HDFC Bank furnished a Form 6-K with an exchange intimation dated October 4, 2026, disclosing quarterly business volumes rather than any transactional event. Average advances under management were INR 31,872 billion for the September 2026 quarter, up 14.0% year over year; period-end gross advances reached INR 32,195 billion, up 16.3%. Period-end deposits were INR 33,275 billion, up 18.8%, with CASA at INR 10,520 billion. Under the RBI FCNR(B) swap facility the bank mobilized USD 11.5 billion of foreign currency deposits and issued USD 2.5 billion of senior unsecured bonds. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were stated; results remain subject to limited review.
